provenance.note: Dev vignette for slice 0009. Never scored. The drafter had read the 17 confidently wrong findings from labels in the twelve scored conversations outside the least-seen three, and writes the agent's fixes too. Classes: self-correction L64; hedged or interpretive L61 and L62 (vague, unresolved), L57 (defer: never exposed, so whether he has a known allergy is interpretation), L63 (defer: whether a pneumonia jab is a live attenuated vaccine) and L65 (defer: whether an inhaled steroid is immunosuppressive medication); polarity L60, L66, L68 and L69 (exclusions worded as prohibitions, all not holding). Controls: L71 and L72 (a man denying pregnancy and breastfeeding, does-not-hold by the scored vignettes' convention, not does-not-apply); L73 (names male and female patients, so it applies to him; a firm willingness, so the exclusion does not hold); L49 (a plain denial). L59 and L70 failed in the twelve; they are answered plainly and test no class.
